DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card's entry symbols are Gymnasium environments, not rosbridge endpoints. RoverEnv builds an rclpy node and drives Gazebo Fortress through ROS topics and an ign service reset (ros2_ws/src/sb3/environments/rover_env.py:78-80, 262-299, 639-655), so this package uses GymnasiumDriver instead of the card's RosDriver and preserves the environment's reset/step interface. The package serves sb3.environments.rover_env:RoverEnv only; the card's other three entry symbols are separate environments and are not served. The fake backend is a ROS-free kinematic stand-in because the upstream class needs ROS 2 Humble, Gazebo Fortress, rclpy, cv_bridge, transforms3d, numpy and the rest of the pinned dependency set, which the gate does not have; the clone is never imported. The fake copies the upstream Box action space (rover_env.py:215-219) and Dict observation space (rover_env.py:226-255), returns the full 32-value lidar array (the upstream lidar_points default, configurable), and marks its start pose, target, lidar reading, per-tick displacement and reward as placeholder test data. Not modelled, and stated in the fidelity gaps: ROS 2 graph and callbacks, Gazebo physics and contacts, LaserScan/IMU/odometry callbacks, the ign service reset, 100 spin_once calls and the 1 s wait, the upstream task_reward/collision/flip/stuck/goal logic, rendering, and snapshot/restore (the upstream class has no get_state/set_state pair). No ROS graph, Gazebo simulator or hardware was run. The G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL warning is the expected bookkeeping case for cap.world.seed.v1: the bridge stores the seed and does not call the environment until reset. The four G8.NO_UNIT warnings are the simulator-family bridge's own derived schemas for ticks, action.values and seed; this package does not override them. The constructor defaults at rover_env.py:71-73 are recorded as facts, not used as limits; the only action bounds are the bridge-derived Box limits with the upstream_code ref, and at R0 no operator-required limit or site-limits overlay is needed.
